name: Santa
summary: A long hat, a white beard, and light the whole way up.
text:
A long red hat speckled with light, a white bobble at the tip, and a beard of pale wood.

A seasonal piece — we make these to order from October, but you can ask for one at any time of year.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
